conbody.p: Import, beside Export, reads a Microsoft Project XML file (in Project: Save as, XML format) and adds its tasks to this project. Each task becomes a card on the board, in To Do, In Progress or Done by its percentage complete, with its dates, its place in the outline, its date constraint and its deadline. A task of no length marked as a milestone becomes a milestone, and the relationships between the tasks follow with their offsets. Resources and calendars are not read. Importing adds to the plan; it replaces nothing, so importing a file twice adds its tasks twice.
